reasoning_chain: Step 1: Silver had been bid to extreme levels (gold/silver ratio near 40-45) based on twin narratives: AI electrification demand and dollar debasement.
Step 2: The electrification/AI demand narrative required a resilient global economy with sustained capex; both are now being repriced lower.
Step 3: Historical precedent from 2011 silver spike: gold/silver ratio eventually converged with Chinese GDP growth as industrial demand failed to materialize sustainably.
Step 4: Chinese GDP remains weak, global industrial demand is deteriorating, and AI capex faces credit constraints — the fundamental support for a low gold/silver ratio never existed.
Step 5: Therefore gold/silver ratio returning to 80-90 is a reversion to fundamentals, with silver continuing to underperform gold as industrial demand repricing continues.
claims.speaker_confidence_signals: Specific numerical targets (80-90 ratio), historical analogy with 2011, references own prior calls on this since mid-2025.
claims.time_horizon_detail: 3-12 months for full ratio reversion
